author: ClubberNugget
body:
Equator

By: Random_Guy

Gamemode: Sky Wars

Teams: Red, Green, Blue and Yellow


Hey everyone, here is a map entry for the contest and for Seth to use in testing his sky wars project.  I hope you find it fitting.

The Concept is the center is the sun and the farther you get from the sun, the platforms get “Colder.”

All Feedback is appreciated and thanks for reading!

Download (No YML)
